title: Simple Hud Edits
description: A resource pack for Minecraft that changes the hud and menus
body:
# THIS WAS MADE FOR FUN❗

**This is NOT FINISHED and is also my first custom thing made for Minecraft!**

**THINGS CAN AND WILL CHANGE WITH NEW VERSIONS!!!**

# What this resource pack will change🎨

This resource pack will change the **Hotbar, Hunger, and Armor Bars** but **will not change the Health, XP, or the Oxygen/Bubble bar** and will also (hopefully) change **every in game menu** when it is fully finnished!

I am trying to make the menus look like they're made of wood or something along those lines.

If you decide to use it I hope you enjoy it :D
